events.title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside
must_haves: One silent 9:16 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.

answer_sheet.Product and reference: No photo; generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
answer_sheet.Shot style: Three moving product shots; backgrounds, lighting and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Caption wording and order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”.
answer_sheet.Caption placement: Every caption, including its full text bounds, must stay at least 15% from each side and 20% from the top and bottom.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Your call; make it easy to read on a phone.
answer_sheet.Format, duration and audio: One silent 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

withheld: There is no photo to use; create the sneaker from scratch.
The sneaker is a plain white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
Make one vertical video, nine units tall for every sixteen units wide turned upright: nine wide and sixteen tall.
The backgrounds, lighting and transitions are up to you.
Show these captions in this order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”.
Keep the full text of every caption at least 15% of the picture width away from each side and 20% of the picture height away from the top and bottom so reel buttons will not cover it.
Caption styling is up to you, but the text should be easy to read on a phone.
